text: Prebuilt drop-in UI components for full user management (sign-up, sign-in, profile)
quote: Clerk's prebuilt UI components give you a beautiful, fully-functional user management experience in minutes.

text: Remote MCP server lets AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) pull Clerk SDK snippets and implementation patterns
quote: Clerk provides a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI agents like Claude, Cursor, and Github Copilot to access Clerk SDK snippets and implementation patterns.

text: Organizations feature groups users with roles/permissions for multi-tenant B2B apps (workspaces, teams, projects)
quote: Organizations let you group users with Roles and Permissions. This lets you build multi-tenant B2B apps like Slack (workspaces), Linear (teams), or Vercel (projects) where users switch between different team contexts.

text: Default admin/member roles plus custom roles and fine-grained permissions for app-specific authorization
quote: Clerk provides two default Roles - admin and member - that cover most common use cases. You can also create custom Roles and fine-grained Permissions that fit your application's specific features and team setup.

text: Webhooks notify your backend of Clerk events like user creation or updates
quote: Clerk webhooks allow you to receive event notifications from Clerk, such as when a user is created or updated.

text: Short-lived JWT session tokens are generated to authenticate requests to your backend
quote: Clerk generates a short-lived session token that you can use to authenticate requests to your backend. This token is a JSON Web Token (JWT) that contains information about the user and their session.

text: Open-source migration tool imports a JSON/CSV list of users into Clerk via the Backend API, respecting rate limits

text: Enterprise SSO lets users sign in with an Identity Provider (Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace) with synced user data
quote: Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) allows users to sign in seamlessly using their Identity Provider (IdP) credentials (e.g.,Azure AD, Okta, or Google Workspace) and have their user data synchronized with Clerk.

text: Enterprise SSO supports multiple protocols including SAML and OIDC
quote: Clerk supports multiple protocols for implementing Enterprise SSO, including SAML and OIDC.

text: Supports second-factor MFA strategies: SMS code, authenticator app, and backup codes
quote: Clerk allows you to enable the following second factor strategies: - MFA: - SMS verification code - Authenticator application - Backup codes

text: Sign-in attempts return a needs_second_factor status to enforce MFA step-up
quote: If you have multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled for your application, the sign-in attempt will return a status of needs_second_factor.

text: OAuth implementation supports scoped access so third-party apps get limited access to user data via Clerk's API
quote: Clerk's OAuth implementation supports OAuth scoped access, which lets third-party applications request limited access to specific parts of a user's data through Clerk's API.

text: Separate API keys (programmatic callers) and M2M tokens (agent-to-agent) provide machine authentication
quote: API keys authenticate programmatic callers; M2M tokens authenticate calls between your agents.

text: Self-serve organization UI lets users create orgs, switch accounts, manage settings/billing, and view memberships/invites
quote: Allow your users to create new organizations, switch between accounts, manage settings and billing, and view memberships and invitations.

text: Pricing table component displays plans with feature comparisons and subscription options
quote: Display pricing plans with feature comparisons and subscription options to help your users choose the right plan for their needs.

text: Waitlist feature collects signups and gates access to features/products before launch
quote: Collect signups and control access to new features or products before launch, with a simple, integrated workflow for developers.

text: Account UI includes SignUp/SignIn components plus a dropdown for profile and security settings
quote: Add user `<SignUp/>` and `<SignIn/>`, provide account access through a dropdown menu, and manage profile and security settings.

text: Can gate individual agent tool calls against caller's Clerk permissions/scopes and broker OAuth tokens on the caller's behalf
quote: Gate individual eve tool calls against the caller's Clerk permissions and scopes — and broker OAuth for tools that need a provider token on the caller's behalf.

text: UI components, email templates, and branding (custom CSS, custom domain) can be fully customized
quote: Customize Clerk's UI components, email templates, and other aspects of the user experience to match your application's branding and user interface.

text: First-party integration adds authentication to Next.js apps
quote: Easily add secure, beautiful, and fast authentication to Next.js with Clerk.

text: Billing support for B2C/B2B apps including free trials, subscription plans, payments, and billing webhook events
quote: Set up and manage Billing for B2C and B2B applications, including free trials, Subscription Plans, payments, and webhook events.

text: Session automatically carries organization context (memberships, roles, active organization) for authorization checks
quote: Users can belong to multiple Organizations, and Clerk provides the Organization context (memberships, Roles, and the Active Organization) in each session.

text: Passkey and device-biometric sign-in are supported as authentication methods
